title: Resolve caching differences in Python 2 vs 3
body:
When hashing a function that returns an object that we can't pickle, python 3 raises a TypeError while python 2 falls back to hashing the name of the non-hashable object.

`get_hash()` therefore raises a TypeError in python 3 but not in python 2.

Evaluate if we can remove the `except` blocks in `_def _code_to_bytes` for python 2 and also handle `None` getting passed to `hasher.update` in `def _update` in hashing.py
